scope: Production server startup and real HTTP/SSE execution of persisted causal artifacts
behavior: Local native and compiled models share admission, per-request KV, generation and UTF-8 assembly; the compiled variant dispatches every matrix projection to its saved programs. --weights supports hash-verified relocation. Legacy scalar directories are rejected during startup.

test_evidence.transport: Two actual server executable instances on OS-assigned ephemeral TCP ports; raw HTTP/1.1 requests and JSON/SSE response decoding
cases: relocated GGUF source supplied through real --weights argument
JSON output exactly é, without prompt echo
SSE pieces [é, empty], exactly one stop and one DONE
oversized prompt returns an explicit HTTP error
saved graph replaced with Zero and its digest updated changes the HTTP result to empty, proving compiled dispatch
child processes terminated and reaped after requests

limitations: The HTTP fixture is zero-layer and isolates startup, stored projection dispatch, token IO and request lifecycle; real-model causal execution is independently recorded in tinyllama-compiled-causal.json.
No real-model HTTP throughput, load-test result, joint numerical batching or full symbolic transformer translation is claimed.
